models/lexus/lx470/years/.title: Lexus LX 470 Years to Avoid & Best Years (2003–05)
models/lexus/lx470/years/.description: The best LX 470 years are 2003–05 (five-speed automatic, new dash), with 2000–02 the cheaper runner-up. Why 2006–07 can cost more to fix, and the recall every 2003–07 truck needs.

models/lexus/lx570/years/.title: Lexus LX 570 Years to Avoid (2008–10) & Best Years to Buy
models/lexus/lx570/years/.description: Avoid 2008–10 LX 570s: they have the most radiator-crack reports, and 2008s had water-pump issues. What 2013–15 and 2016-on trucks add, year by year, with recalls.

models/lexus/gx550/years/.title: Lexus GX 550 Years to Avoid: Is 2024 the Problem Year?
models/lexus/gx550/years/.description: 2024 is the one documented GX 550 problem year: recall 25V-767 covers V35A machining debris in early trucks. How to check the VIN, and what changed for 2025.

models/nissan-patrol/y61/years/.title: Nissan Patrol GU (Y61) Years to Avoid & Best Years to Buy
models/nissan-patrol/y61/years/.description: Which GU Patrol to avoid: be wary of 2000–03 ZD30 diesels. The TD42 years, especially the 2005–07 TD42T ST and ST-L, are the sweet spot for reliability. Every Y61 year, with recalls.

models/unimog/unimog-u1300l/specs/.title: Unimog U1300L Specs: OM 352 Engine, Fluids & Oil Type
models/unimog/unimog-u1300l/specs/.description: Unimog U1300L (435) specs: OM 352 5.7 L six-cylinder diesel (OM 366 from 1987), 8-speed gearbox, fluid capacities and oil grades, including ex-Bundeswehr trucks.

models/g-class/best-years/.title: G-Wagon Years to Avoid (2002–04) & Most Reliable Years (2005–08)
models/g-class/best-years/.description: The most reliable G-Wagon years are the 2005–08 W463s; avoid 2002–04. Europa G-Classes: best 1999–2000, avoid 1994–98. Every generation, with the reasons.
